$comment: Requirements for the GitHub multi-customer sync task. Verifier-owned: the model never sees this file. Never name a Trigger.dev function, import, or primitive here -- the checks infer which primitive was used. Omit a key (or set it false) and its check reports n/a and drops out of the score, so only state what the task actually asks for.

$mapping.concurrencyMustBeManaged: 'customer shouldnt be consuming all the server capacity' -- capacity has to be bounded by the platform, not by the app
$mapping.mustIsolateTenantThroughput: same line plus 'resolve them fairly' -- a global cap alone lets whoever enqueues first hold every slot, so fairness needs per-customer partitioning
$mapping.transientFailuresMustRecover: 'no ... system failiurs' -- GitHub rate limits and 5xx are the normal case here
$mapping.mustSurviveInterruption: 'no issues in processing' across deploys and worker restarts
$mapping.mustIsolateConcurrentRuns: 'there should be no conflicts in syncing' -- a manual sync overlapping a scheduled one must not corrupt shared state
$mapping.mustNotDuplicateOnReplay: 'no conflicts in syncing' -- the same repo must not be synced twice when a sync is re-run or retried
$mapping.failureMustBeIsolated: 'no issues in processing' -- one repo failing must not abort the rest
$mapping.mustReportPerItemOutcome: required to report which repo failed; same evidence the isolation requirement depends on

$inferred: mustDispatchItemsTogether, mustWaitForAllTerminal, schedulesMustBePerTenant and mustPrioritiseWork are NOT stated in the brief -- see the notes. Drop any of them if you do not sharpen the task text, or the model will be marked down for something it was never told.
